section_summary.extract_value: Section 2.2.3 describes the Functionality Appreciation Scale (FAS; Alleva, Tylka, & Kroon Van Diest, 2017), a 7-item measure rated from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree), scored as the mean across items. It reports that scores are one-dimensional, invariant across sex, and that in the present study the ordinal coefficient for the scale was .92. The section does not provide sample characteristics, BMI information, BAS/BAS-2 assessment, correlations, or study count.
section_summary.evidence_source: "To assess functionality appreciation, we asked participants to complete the Functionality Appreciation Scale (FAS; Alleva, Tylka, & Kroon Van Diest, 2017)." and "In the present study, ordinal coefficient for this scale was .92."
